name: CPython runtime (python312.dll and the standard library)
note: Each frozen sidecar carries the Python 3.12 interpreter and standard library that PyInstaller bundles. Licence: the Python Software Foundation License Version 2, https://docs.python.org/3.12/license.html. Source: https://www.python.org/downloads/source/.

name: PyInstaller bootloader
note: Every frozen sidecar executable is PyInstaller's bootloader followed by the program's archive. The bootloader is GPL-2.0-or-later with a special exception that allows the frozen program to be distributed under any licence: https://github.com/pyinstaller/pyinstaller/blob/develop/COPYING.txt. Source: https://github.com/pyinstaller/pyinstaller.

name: OpenSSL 3 (libcrypto-3.dll, libssl-3.dll)
note: Bundled with the Python runtime for its ssl and hashlib modules. Licence: Apache License 2.0, https://www.openssl.org/source/license.html. Source: https://github.com/openssl/openssl.

name: libffi (libffi-8.dll)
note: Bundled with the Python runtime for ctypes. Licence: MIT, https://github.com/libffi/libffi/blob/master/LICENSE.

name: Microsoft Visual C++ runtime (msvcp140.dll, vcruntime140.dll and companions)
note: Redistributed as the Visual C++ Redistributable files that the Python runtime and the native wheels link to, under Microsoft's redistribution terms: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/cpp/windows/redistributing-visual-cpp-files. Not open source; not modified.

name: FFmpeg libraries vendored in the PyAV wheel (av.libs: avcodec, avformat, avutil, avfilter, avdevice, swscale, swresample and the codecs beside them)
source: transcript-compare, manuscript-teleprompter (through PyAV 18.1.0, which faster-whisper uses to decode audio)
note: PyAV's wheel carries its own build of FFmpeg 8.1.2 and the libraries it links: libdav1d (BSD-2-Clause), libmp3lame (LGPL-2.0-or-later), opencore-amr (Apache-2.0), libopus (BSD-3-Clause), SVT-AV1 (BSD-3-Clause-Clear), libvpx (BSD-3-Clause), libwebp (BSD-3-Clause), libvpl (MIT), libx264 and libx265 (GPL, per their projects), zlib (Zlib), libiconv (LGPL-2.1-or-later), and the MinGW runtime (libgcc, libstdc++, libwinpthread; GPL-3.0-or-later with the GCC Runtime Library Exception, and MIT). Measured on 2026-09-21 by calling avutil_license() in the PyAV 18.1.0 wheel: FFmpeg reports 'LGPL version 3 or later'. NOT verified: whether enabling libx264 and libx265 makes this build GPL, and the exact licence of libx265; both are compatible with AGPL-3.0-or-later unless a component is GPL-2.0-only. Sources: https://github.com/PyAV-Org/PyAV (build scripts) and https://ffmpeg.org/download.html; each component's own site has its source. Only decoding is used by Narration Utils.

name: OpenBLAS and the MinGW runtime vendored in the numpy wheel (numpy.libs)
note: numpy's wheel carries OpenBLAS (BSD-3-Clause) and the GCC runtime libraries it links (libgfortran, libquadmath, libgcc: GPL-3.0-or-later with the GCC Runtime Library Exception). The numpy entry above carries numpy's own bundled licence file (LICENSES_bundled.txt) with the full texts. Source: https://github.com/OpenMathLib/OpenBLAS and https://gcc.gnu.org.

name: eSpeak NG data and library inside piper-tts (piper/espeak-ng-data)
note: The piper-tts wheel bundles eSpeak NG and its data to phonemize text. Licence: GPL-3.0-or-later (with parts under other licences named in the eSpeak NG repository's COPYING files). Source: https://github.com/espeak-ng/espeak-ng and https://github.com/OHF-voice/piper1-gpl. Narration Utils is AGPL-3.0-or-later (ADR 0039), which is compatible.

name: Silero VAD model (silero_vad_v6.onnx) inside the faster-whisper wheel
note: A voice-activity-detection model that faster-whisper ships as package data and the sidecars collect (ADR 0022). Licence: MIT, https://github.com/snakers4/silero-vad/blob/master/LICENSE.

name: ONNX Runtime inside the moonshine-voice wheel (moonshine_voice/onnxruntime.dll)
note: The moonshine-voice wheel carries its own build of Microsoft's ONNX Runtime (file version 1.23.20251021.3) beside its moonshine.dll, which loads it; the Teleprompter sidecar collects both (scripts/release/prepare-resources.py). It is separate from the onnxruntime Python package faster-whisper uses. Licence: MIT, https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/blob/main/LICENSE. Source: https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime.

name: Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime (not in this package)
source: the setup program and the interface
note: The interface is drawn by the WebView2 runtime that Windows 11 includes (or that Microsoft's evergreen bootstrapper installs when the setup program finds it missing). It is Microsoft's software, distributed under Microsoft's terms (https://developer.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-edge/webview2/), and is not part of this package's files.
